0.title: Gaming instructions
0.body:
Trench Crusade Table (dev) - a fork of LCT v1.12.1 with the Warhammer 40k systems removed.
- **Red, Blue, or Spectator seats** - Choose a player side or watch the game.
- **Game modes** - Each button on the start menu scales the table to a battlefield size and starts a singles-style game.
- **Deployment zone picker** - Draws a deployment overlay on the table; the in-game toggle buttons show/hide it.
- **Kept from LCT** - tokens, counters, auras/bubbles, dice mats and rollers, save/restore positions, LOS markers, chess clock, HUD, auto-seat, table themes, terrain tools.
- **Removed** - missions, secondaries, CP, 40k scoring, map/Battlemaster caches. See mod/STRIP-LOG.md and mod/TESTING.md in the repo.
